title: Witness 'Ed': $34B and $40B scrubbed from Air Force books
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range; Edwards AFB; Pentagon

tellings.quote: So, I covered once a witness code named Ed who talked of a joint reverse engineering program between the Nevada Test and Trade Range and Edwards Air Force Base.

plain: A witness code-named Ed described a joint reverse-engineering program, an effort to take apart unknown craft and learn how they work, run between the Nevada Test and Training Range, a military testing area, and Edwards Air Force Base, with 34 billion and then 40 billion dollars wiped from Air Force accounts between 2012 and 2016. The tale comes from a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb and says he once covered Ed's account. If true, huge sums were hidden to fund the program.
